title: Multi-Language Portfolio Balance
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=lesson:complete OR sourcetype=immersion:log)
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes by language _time
| stats sum(minutes) as total by language
| sort - total
description: Tracks how you split study time across the languages you are learning, guarding against neglecting one.
value: Polyglots easily let one language slide; a portfolio view keeps a chosen balance intentional rather than accidental.
implementation: Ingest study time by language into `index=personal`; compare totals across languages.
visualization: Bar chart of study time by language.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how you split your time across the languages you are learning, so none gets neglected.
